job_id.description: Identifier of the engine-owned refresh job, observable through jobs.get and stoppable through jobs.cancel. There is no public job-create operation; this method is the entry point that makes the job exist.

job_kind.description: The kind of job that was started; always "com.modeldeck.engine.prices.refresh" for this method.

explicit_network.description: Always true when present: this job reaches the network because the caller asked it to, never as a side effect of a read.
